readme:
# D3PO 逐去噪步骤偏好优化

## 1. 问题

把终点偏好传到各去噪步骤，并在每一步计算参考策略校正的偏好损失。

实现给定轨迹 log-prob 的逐步 D3PO 损失；不把多步概率先相乘。

## 2. 核心公式

$$
z_{bt}=\beta[(\ell^w_{bt}-\ell^{w,ref}_{bt})-(\ell^l_{bt}-\ell^{l,ref}_{bt})],\qquad L=\frac1{BT}\sum_{bt}\operatorname{softplus}(-z_{bt}).
$$

## 3. 公式到代码

```python
d3po_loss(preferred: Tensor, rejected: Tensor, ref_preferred: Tensor, ref_rejected: Tensor, beta: float) -> Tensor
```

先分别计算胜出和落选轨迹相对参考策略的 log 比率，再在相同时间步相减。每个时间步有独立的 sigmoid 分类任务，最后才对批次与时间求均值。

## 4. 本题约定

preferred/rejected/ref_preferred/ref_rejected: equal (B,T) finite log probabilities. beta>0. Return a scalar mean over B and T after the per-step softplus.

Both current preferred and rejected log probabilities differentiate; both reference tensors are detached.

## 5. 交互图与实验

实验使用你提交的函数。图中各点来自实际运行结果。

A three-step preference model learns independently signed transition margins through 60 gradient updates.

## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 延伸

与对整条轨迹求和后再分类的目标比较梯度。

[Using Human Feedback to Fine-tune Diffusion Models without Any Reward Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.13231) · Section 4.3 Eq. (14): a preference objective for every state-action pair
notes:
# 题解与常见错误

先分别计算胜出和落选轨迹相对参考策略的 log 比率，再在相同时间步相减。每个时间步有独立的 sigmoid 分类任务，最后才对批次与时间求均值。

$$
z_{bt}=\beta[(\ell^w_{bt}-\ell^{w,ref}_{bt})-(\ell^l_{bt}-\ell^{l,ref}_{bt})],\qquad L=\frac1{BT}\sum_{bt}\operatorname{softplus}(-z_{bt}).
$$

Both current preferred and rejected log probabilities differentiate; both reference tensors are detached.

先求时间和再做 softplus 对应另一种目标；正负时间步会抵消。参考模型必须冻结，但落选轨迹的当前模型仍需梯度。

测试依据：不等的逐步 margin 手算、时间重复不变性、参考梯度冻结及极端 margin 稳定性。

## 实验标定

固定种子 42，CPU float64，直接梯度下降；无需数据下载。以下是参考解实际测量，不是预设轨迹。 PyTorch 2.14.1. lr=.3 (60 updates).

```json
{"final": 0.0839873427692218, "initial": 0.6931471805599453, "minimum_margin": 1.368771445818979}
```

验收阈值见 `tests/test_core.py::test_real_toy_experiment`；基线为训练前参数的实际输出。

en.title: D3PO Per-Transition Preference Optimization
en.readme:
# D3PO Per-Transition Preference Optimization

## 1. Problem

Propagate terminal preferences to denoising transitions and compute reference-corrected preference losses per step.

Implement stepwise D3PO from trajectory log probabilities, without collapsing them into one trajectory-level likelihood.

## 2. Core equations

$$
z_{bt}=\beta[(\ell^w_{bt}-\ell^{w,ref}_{bt})-(\ell^l_{bt}-\ell^{l,ref}_{bt})],\qquad L=\frac1{BT}\sum_{bt}\operatorname{softplus}(-z_{bt}).
$$

## 3. From equations to code

```python
d3po_loss(preferred: Tensor, rejected: Tensor, ref_preferred: Tensor, ref_rejected: Tensor, beta: float) -> Tensor
```

Compute winner and loser log ratios relative to their references, then subtract at matching timesteps. Each transition has its own logistic objective; average over batch and time only afterward.

## 4. Contract

preferred/rejected/ref_preferred/ref_rejected: equal (B,T) finite log probabilities. beta>0. Return a scalar mean over B and T after the per-step softplus.

Both current preferred and rejected log probabilities differentiate; both reference tensors are detached.

## 5. Visualization and experiment

The experiment calls your submitted functions; plotted points are measured results.

A three-step preference model learns independently signed transition margins through 60 gradient updates.

## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Extensions

Compare gradients against a classifier on summed trajectory log ratios.

[Using Human Feedback to Fine-tune Diffusion Models without Any Reward Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.13231) · Section 4.3 Eq. (14): a preference objective for every state-action pair
en.notes:
# Solution reasoning and pitfalls

Compute winner and loser log ratios relative to their references, then subtract at matching timesteps. Each transition has its own logistic objective; average over batch and time only afterward.

$$
z_{bt}=\beta[(\ell^w_{bt}-\ell^{w,ref}_{bt})-(\ell^l_{bt}-\ell^{l,ref}_{bt})],\qquad L=\frac1{BT}\sum_{bt}\operatorname{softplus}(-z_{bt}).
$$

Both current preferred and rejected log probabilities differentiate; both reference tensors are detached.

Summing across time before softplus changes the objective and cancels opposing timestep margins. Freeze the references, while retaining gradients through both current branches.

Test basis: Unequal per-step margins, timestep-duplication invariance, frozen-reference gradients and stable extreme margins.

## Experiment calibration

Seed 42, CPU float64, direct gradient descent, no downloaded data. Values below were measured from the reference, not a preset trajectory. PyTorch 2.14.1. lr=.3 (60 updates).

```json
{"final": 0.0839873427692218, "initial": 0.6931471805599453, "minimum_margin": 1.368771445818979}
```

Acceptance thresholds are in `tests/test_core.py::test_real_toy_experiment`; the baseline is the measured output before training.
